dedupe_keys.name: historical dataset of reservoir operation over the contiguous united states

description: Historical Dataset of Reservoir Operation over the Contiguous United States is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Zeng, Ruijie (deposited on HydroShare). Reservoirs are the key hydraulic infrastructure that regulates natural streamflow variability to fulfill various operation targets, including flood control, water supply, hydroelectricity generation and sustaining environmental flow. Coverage: United States. The resource was created 2022-10-10 and last updated 2023-06-01; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
